title: Code outside jest roots (replay-shared) must trigger full frontend jest run
answers: Why did frontend jest tests not run when I changed common/replay-shared?
How do I make a package outside jest roots trigger full frontend tests in CI?
Mobile replay parsing snapshot went stale after replay-shared change
body:
The frontend jest selector uses `--findRelatedTests`, which cannot trace imports from source outside the jest roots. `common/replay-shared/src/**` is such a location, so its frontend consumers (e.g. mobile-replay parsing tests) were silently omitted.
Enforced in `.github/workflows/ci-frontend.yml`: (1) the `frontend_code` paths-filter in the `changes` job includes `common/replay-shared/src/**`; (2) the selection script's `case "$f"` loop calls `fall_back unindexed_dependency "$f"` for `common/replay-shared/src/*`, running the full suite. Draft PRs still skip.
Any new source dir outside the jest roots that frontend imports needs the same treatment in BOTH places. The case-loop patterns are meant to mirror the `frontend_code` filter.
applies: CI frontend jest selection in .github/workflows/ci-frontend.yml; packages/dirs outside frontend jest roots
